report_name: Armored Likho APT Targets Russia With New 'Still Toolkit'

threat_actors.name: Armored Likho
threat_actors.description: A cyber-espionage group that has been observed deploying the 'Still Toolkit', a new Rust-based malware suite, in a campaign targeting entities within Russia since May 2026.

attack_patterns.name: Phishing
attack_patterns.description: The attackers used social engineering with fundraising-themed lures to entice targets into executing the malware.

attack_patterns.name: Malicious File
attack_patterns.description: Victims were tricked into running malicious applications disguised with fundraising-themed lures.

attack_patterns.name: Credentials from Password Stores
attack_patterns.description: The 'Still Sync' malware component steals Telegram session data from the victim's machine, allowing attackers to hijack the account.

attack_patterns.name: Audio Capture
attack_patterns.description: The 'Still Audio' malware component accesses the victim's microphone to covertly record conversations when human speech is detected.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: The 'Still Audio' component exfiltrates recorded audio to a command-and-control server.

malware.name: Still Toolkit
malware.description: A new, sophisticated Rust-based espionage toolset deployed by Armored Likho. It is designed for intelligence gathering and includes components for Telegram session hijacking and audio surveillance.

malware.name: Still Sync
malware.description: A component of the Still Toolkit that specializes in locating and exfiltrating Telegram session data to hijack victim accounts.

malware.name: Still Audio
malware.description: An audio surveillance component of the Still Toolkit that records audio from the victim's microphone upon detecting human speech and exfiltrates the recordings to a C2 server.

identities.name: Russian individuals and organizations
identities.description: A wide range of victims within Russia targeted by the Armored Likho APT, including private citizens, major corporations, government organizations, and educational institutions.

infrastructure.name: Still Toolkit C2 Server
infrastructure.description: Command-and-control server used by the Still Toolkit to exfiltrate stolen Telegram session data and recorded audio.

indicators.name: Still Toolkit Executable Detection
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: Still Toolkit Executable Process Creation
id: 2b8c1d9e-f1a0-4b9c-8d7e-6a5b4c3d2e1f
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of processes associated with the Still Toolkit malware.
references:
  - https://securelist.com/armored-likho-still-toolkit/121033/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-13
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1204.002
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\still_sync.exe'
      - '\still_audio.exe'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of Still Toolkit components 'still_sync.exe' and 'still_audio.exe'.

indicators.name: Suspicious Telegram Session Access
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Process Accessing Telegram Session Data
id: 9e8f7d6c-5b4a-4c3d-2e1f-0a9b8c7d6e5f
status: experimental
description: Detects processes other than the official Telegram client accessing the Telegram session data folder. This may indicate theft of session data by malware like Still Sync.
references:
  - https://securelist.com/armored-likho-still-toolkit/121033/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-13
tags:
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1555
level: medium
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|contains: '\Telegram Desktop\tdata\'
  filter:
    Image|endswith: '\Telegram.exe'
  condition: selection and not filter
indicators.description: Detects processes other than the official Telegram client accessing the Telegram session data folder, a behavior associated with the 'Still Sync' malware.
